access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3450). A Black wood sawyer at work in a town street, 1842: a white shirt over a red flannel one, its sleeves pushed up, a brown waistcoat worn open, dark trousers, boots and a battered black hat. Seven years after the scene, an eastern town, not Chicago.
note: One of the 1835 labourer reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/labourer_1835.json).
